contexts.text: See Coat. AC 4412. AC 4622:4.
Their eyes were opened = they perceived that they were in evil.
Such open eyes have they.
Their eyes became opened () = a dictate from within.
The eyes in the Word often = the understanding, thus an inward dictate thence. Illustrated.
They have eyes as it were of serpents...
To lift up the eyes () = to see; in the internal sense, to perceive; here, to be illuminated, because it is predicated of... the external man.
The eye itself, properly speaking, is nothing but the sight of the spirit led out of doors.
Spirits seeing through a man's eyes. Explained. AC 1954:2. AC 2309. AC 4415:2. AC 9791. AC 10813:2. WE 4912. SE 2106. SE 2247. SE 3306. SE 3902. SE 3963.
Occurs. AC 1921. AC 2572.
Their eyes are consumed () = no apprehension of what truth is.
Under Vision, see this reference. AC 1972.
Rays darting into the left eye.
The internal sight or understanding is expressed in the Word by the eye. AC 2148. AC 2271.
He lifted up his eyes () = that he saw within himself.
In their eyes () = before their Rational.
Eyes = intellectual things.
God opened her eyes () = intelligence... The eyes = the understanding. Illustrated.
The left eye = what is intellectual; the right eye = its affection.
In front, before the left eye...
Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw () = thought and mental prospect from the Divine. The eyes = intelligence; and therefore to lift up the eyes = to elevate the intelligence, thus to think. AC 2829.
To the eyes of the sons of my people give I it thee () = as to the understanding of them all.
The light of the body is the eye... (). The eye = the Intellectual which is of the soul.
To the eyes of the sons of Heth () = to their understanding.
The interior affections show themselves from and in the eyes. AC 4407:2. AC 5165:2.
To lift up the eyes = to think; here, intention. AC 3202. AC 4083. AC 4086. AC 4339. AC 4746. AC 4988.
The internal eye, that is, the understanding...
Suddenly their eyes were opened...
See Darkness.
To be in his eyes () = to be apperceived as to what his quality is; for the eye = the apperception of the internal sight. AC 3827.
Under Atmosphere, see this reference.
The eye is only an organ of the body through which the internal man sees those things which are outside the body.
Under Ether, see this reference.
The eyes of Leah were weak () = that the affection of external truth was such as to its understanding.
Lest he see with his eyes () = to deprive of the understanding of truth.
They have eyes to see, but do not see () = that they are able to understand the truths of faith, but do not want to do so.
They who are intellectual and are thence in faith, belong to the province of the eye.
His eyes redder than wine () = the Divine wisdom.
A little star seen near the region of the left eye.
The interior animus, or the mind, shines from the eyes.
The memory, which is like an internal eye...

This may be illustrated by comparison with the sight of the eye... When the eye sees objects, it apperceives pleasantness and delight... This pleasantness and delight are not of the eye, but of the animus and its affections...
Under Right, see this reference.
The left eye = what is intellectual.
On Correspondence with the eye. General article. AC 4523.
They who are at the eyes are they who are intelligent and wise.

The eye is the most noble organ of the face, and communicates more immediately with the understanding than the other sensory organs of man. It is also modified by a more subtle atmosphere than the ear; and therefore the sight penetrates to the internal sensory by a shorter and more interior way than speech... And hence it is that some animals, being short of understanding, have as it were two subsidiary brains within the orbits of their eyes...
The objects of the world... enter through the eye...

The sight of the left eye corresponds to the truths which are of the understanding, and the right eye to the affections of truth which also are of the understanding; thus the left eye corresponds to the truths of faith, and the right eye to the goods of faith.
Each and all things which are in the eye have their correspondences in the Heavens. Explained.
The correspondence of the sight of the eye is with the things which belong to the understanding; for the understanding is the internal sight...
The eye, or rather its sight, corresponds especially to those Societies in the other life who are in paradisiacal things...
These... also belong to the provinces of the eyes.
They who are in the other life cannot see anything whatever in the world through the eyes of any man. The reason they could do so through mine... AC 5862:end.
I did not see with the eyes of my body those with whom I spoke in the other life, but with the eyes of my spirit; sometimes more clearly than with the eyes of my body...

They perceived whatever happens in the Society in general, but not so much in particular as they who are in the province of the eye; for these latter discriminate and view the things which belong to perception.
They thus perceived that these angelic Societies were from the province of the eye. SE 4029.
Grace is said to be found in the eyes, because grace is predicated of what is intellectual.

This he sees with his eyes, not those which he had in the world, but those which he has there, which belong to his internal man; and from which through the eyes of the body he had before seen worldly and earthly things.
The suction towards the eye was from Spirits, that towards the ear was from Genii.

In his eyes is said from a customary form of speaking, because the eye = the interior sight, thus understanding, perception, advertence, and many things which belong to that sight. References. AC 5305.
It is said that they were full of eyes before and behind, because the eyes = intellectual things; and therefore, in a higher sense, the things which are of faith. References.
To their eyes () = to apperception.

I will set my eye upon him () = the influx then of truth from good. (For) to set the eye upon anyone = to communicate the truth of faith. The eye corresponds to the intellectual sight and to the truths of faith.
Let there not be anger in your eyes () = sadness of the spirit or of the understanding.
To place the hand upon the eyes () = to vivify; for to place the hand upon the eyes means that the external Sensuous... is closed, and the internal Sensuous is opened...
The eye is formed to all the nature of the ether and of light. AC 6057. SE 4063.
The intellectual mind, which is man's internal eye... AC 6068:2.
Seen by the eyes of the spirit...
The eye is always directed to that which the most affects and delights it...
Under Die, see this reference.
Israel's eyes were heavy () = his obscure apperception.
His eyes are red with wine () = that the Intellectual or internal man is nothing but good. Explained. AC 9052:2.

Their speech fell towards my left eye, although they were on my right. The reason was that the left eye corresponds to Knowledges of things which are abstracted from material things, thus to the things which belong to intelligence; but the right eye, to the things which belong to wisdom.
He did signs to the eyes of the people () = confirmation to the apprehension... The eyes = the things which belong to the internal sight or understanding.

The Sun of Heaven... appears before the right eye... for the right eye corresponds not only to the intellectual sight in so far as it is illuminated by truth, but also in so far as it is illuminated by good...
In the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants () = in the perception of all those who are in falsities. (For) the eyes = perception. AC 7331.
With the inhabitants of Mars the affection itself of their speech is represented in the face, and its thought in the eyes...
As an injured eye cannot bear even the gentle rays of the sun.
For a memorial between the eyes () = that it is perpetually in the understanding. AC 8090.
Israel lifted up his eyes () = the Intellectual of the mind, and thought... To lift up the eyes = mental view, perception, and thought.
Under Speak, see this reference.
In the eyes of Jehovah = before the Lord, thus according to His precepts... He, also, is said to be in the eyes of the Lord who is in faith in Him.
The case is the same with the sight of the internal eye, which is the understanding; in order for it to see it must have light...

Jehovah will come down to the eyes of all the people () = the advent of the Lord, and enlightenment then... In the internal sense, the eye = the understanding; and thence the sight of the eye = the perception which is of faith. References.
The eye = the understanding of truth. References. AC 9049:end.
The concupiscence of evil is meant by the right eye offending.
The eye corresponds to faith; the left eye, to the truth of faith, and the right eye to the good of faith; in the opposite sense, to the evil which is of faith.
In the eyes () = in the perception.
An eye for an eye... An eye = the interior truth of faith.
An eye for an eye () = if they injure anything in the interior Intellectual. An eye = the understanding; here, interior understanding, the life of which is the life of faith.

The reason the eye = the understanding, is that the eye corresponds to the understanding; for the understanding sees from the light of Heaven, and the eye from the light of the world; the things which the former eye sees are spiritual, and the field of its view is the Scientific which is in man's memory... AC 9051:2, Illustrated.
That the eye = the understanding, and also faith, because the latter constitutes the life of the interior understanding. References.

When a man shall smite the eye of his servant () = if the internal man shall injure the truth of faith in the external man... The eye = the interior understanding, and thence the truth of faith. AC 9059. AC 9061.
As the eye cannot see the things which are in itself, but those which are out of itself.
A gift blinds those who have their eyes open () = that gains cause truths not to appear... They who have their eyes open = those who know truths, and clearly see what is true.
The eye () = faith, and thence intelligence.
Which were seen in Heaven with the eyes of the spirit. Signified.
(The grossness of the natural eyes.) HH 76.
Hence when the light of the world is taken away from the bodily eye, the eyes of the spirit are opened...
Under East, see this reference.
The Sun opposite the right eye; the Moon opposite the left eye. AC 10130:4, Explained. HH 118.
(Those Angels) were seen with the eyes of their spirits. LJCont 34.
The eyes = the understanding of truth; and when predicated of the Lord, the Divine intelligence and wisdom. References.
The things of wisdom and intelligence are in the province of the eyes.
It is said between the eyes (), because the eyes = the intelligence and wisdom which are from love to Jehovah God; and the wisdom from that love is to have God continually before the eyes.
The eyes = the things which belong to the internal sight, thus the truths of faith. References.
The right eye () = the knowledge of good applied to confirm what is false.
The right eye (which offends) = the understanding and faith of falsity from evil.
See Earth. AC 10316.
As when the eye is disordered (it sees accordingly).
Thoughts which are from affections appear from the eyes.
In the eyes of Jehovah = the Lord's presence in the truths and goods of faith and love with men... and Angels... Illustrated.

Eyes in the Word, when predicated of men who receive the Divine things of the Lord, = faith, and also a recipient understanding; for the understanding is the internal eye; and faith is the truth which is seen and perceived. References.
Angels cannot be seen by man with the eyes of his body, but with the eyes of the spirit...
They who are in the eyes are in understanding.
Hence the eyes = the understanding. HH 145. HH 549:end. DP 264:3. AR 48, Illustrated.
The reason the Lord appears before the eyes, is that the interiors of the mind see through the eyes; from the good of love, through the right eye; and from the good of faith, through the left eye.
The eye corresponds to intelligence, and intelligence is of doctrine.
All little children there are in the province of the eyes; those who are of a spiritual genius are in the province of the left eye; and those of a celestial genius in that of the right eye.
Such things as appear before the eyes are first insinuated.
Therefore when the material of the eye is veiled over and deprived of its cooperation with the spiritual, Spirits appear...
His eyes a flame of fire = the Divine truth from the Divine good of His Divine love. AR 48. AR 822.
Thought from the eye closes the understanding, but thought from the understanding opens the eye.
The eyes of the Angels are of the substance of their world.
The thoughts which are of wisdom appear in a certain light in the eyes.
The eye corresponds to wisdom and its perceptions.
The understanding sees in the eye... and not contrariwise.
Every eye shall see Him () = that all will acknowledge Him who from affection are in the understanding of Divine truth. AE 37.
In their state of vision, the eyes of their spirits were opened, and the eyes of their bodies were closed.
The eye in these passages = the understanding of truth.
Hence, the eye, when predicated of the Lord, = His Divine wisdom; and also omniscience and providence. Illustrated. AE 68. AE 152, Explained, Illustrated.
When they had been cast out their eyes were opened...
Anoint thine eyes with eye-salve, that thou mayest see () = that the understanding may be healed, lest the genuine truths of wisdom be profaned and falsified. AE 245.
Full of eyes before and behind () = the Divine wisdom therein. AE 277.
They were full of eyes within () = the Divine wisdom in the Word in the natural sense from its spiritual and celestial sense. AE 284.
Seven eyes () = His omniscience and Divine wisdom. AE 317.
The second class of the tribes correspond to the eyes together with the nostrils.
They look back at the Lord through the eyes, because... the eyes correspond to the truths from that good.
Presently their eyes are opened, and they see a way...
From his eyes darted light sparkling with the wisdom of love.
After we had entered the forest, our eyes were opened.
[155a] 2. The wives looked into my eyes acutely; and I asked, Why do you do so? They said, We are able exquisitely to see what is your inclination and consequent affection...
It appears as if the allurement enters through the eyes as it were through doors into the mind...
The pupils of their eyes as it were lightened in a green plane. CL 5M 2. CL 3.
The straining of my eye-sight affected them.
Not the eye which sees... but the spirit.
After this their eyes were opened, and they saw us near them.
(Correspondence of diseases of the eye.)
Like the eye of a fish.
(The conjunction of the two eyes is not alternate, but mutual; and the same with the conjunction of light with the eye.)
In His glorified Human He cannot appear to any man until He has first opened the eyes of his spirit...
On the province of the eye.
The left eye corresponds to the right side of the brain, and the right eye to the left side of it. SE 1027.
(On the structure and substances of the eye.)
The same Spirit acted into both my eyes...
Her eyes were red, as though weak. Explained.
They appear in the plane of the left eye.
These come by deceit into the region of the left eye...
These now irritate my left eye... SE 3664.
They directed my eyes to filth, etc. SE 2852.
Evil Spirits... with their eyes, as it were the points of thoughts... continually harassed me.
In the corner of the right eye are they who live a paradisiacal life.
To which corresponds the vitreous humour of the eye.
Represented that garments are left in the left eye...
The same women induced a weakness in the right eye. Hence it was given to know why Leah is described as weak in the eyes. SE 3469:end.
Rays appeared to go forth from his eyes. SE 3541.
A hand shown before the left eye.
Those who correspond to the outer coats of the left eye. Described.
Because the right eye represents affections.
(He passed) through the exteriors of the left eye into the brain.
This influx both began and was terminated about the eyes, as it were extending itself from the left eye...
The point of a spear is vibrated before their left eye.
Shown by a view into the eye, where is the intellectual gift.
On those who injure the left eye.
They do not indeed see the world through his eyes...
That which enters only through the eye enters into the understanding, and places itself in the memory...
He poured his persuasive into their eyes... LJPost 27.
The objects which only lightly strike the eye (enter the ideas) and can be recalled.
The reason the eye = faith. Explained.
A sword upon the right eye () = the destruction of the Intellectual as to truth.
To have the eyes opened, or to have the eyes uncovered () = to be enlightened as to the understanding.
The eye, in the Word, = the understanding of truth, or intelligence and wisdom. Illustrated. AE 274:3. AE 357:24.
The right eye = the understanding of good; and the left eye, the understanding of truth.
The eyes closed () = no understanding.
Wise in their own eyes () = from their Own intelligence.
The eyes correspond to the understanding.
The eyes = the understanding. AE 455:8. AE 484. AE 622:7. AE 710:24. AE 750:14.
The eyes of the glory of Jehovah () = the Divine truth.
The eyes especially are representative of the affection of love; for love shines from them, for they sparkle with it as with fire.
The eye pure, or simple = the understanding of truth from good; the eye evil = the understanding of falsity from evil.
An eye for an eye = that in proportion as anyone takes away the understanding of truth from another, it is taken away from him.
His eyes red with wine = that His Intellectual was Divine truth from Divine good.
The eyes, in the Word, = the understanding of truth. AE 577:7.
If thy right eye offend thee = that if evil be thought of it must be ejected from the thought.
The eyes = understanding and faith. AE 1081:2. AE 1081:3. AE 1081:4.
The eyes, in the Word, correspond to the understanding, and thence signify it; and here it = one who is enlightened, and thus has his eyes opened.
Seven eyes in one stone () = the Divine wisdom and intelligence which are of Divine truth, thus of the Word.
The eyes, in the Word, = the understanding of truth. AE 852.
As the Spiritual Heavens correspond to the eyes, there are paradisiacal things there...
The rays of light convey... their forms and colours to the eye, which forms, being perceived in the eye, are examined by the internal sight, which is called the understanding...

3. The eye does not see from itself, but by means of continuity from the understanding. The understanding sees through the eye, and also moves the eye, determines it to objects, and strains its sight.
